_meta.description: Addresses whose USDT Tether has frozen. A match means the funds touched a wallet the stablecoin's issuer has acted against.
_meta.provenance: Replayed from the USDT contract's own AddedBlackList / RemovedBlackList events (0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7) by backend/scripts/import_tether_freezes.py. An address is listed if its most recent event is a freeze.
_meta.verification_note: A random sample of frozen and released addresses was checked against the contract's own isBlackListed(address) and every answer agreed with the replay. A freeze establishes that Tether acted on the address; it does NOT say why (sanctions, a law-enforcement request, a theft), and it is not a finding that a counterparty took part in anything.
_meta.schema: labels maps an address to {category, entity, label, source}
